assets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and emerald RAZE outfits wear rainbow knee-high socks and pumps on Jurmala's Dzintari boardwalk as the two women at right share a kiss.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze-teal, blue-copper, ruby, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear rainbow knee-highs and pumps on an autumn terrace at Cesis Castle Park with stylized smoke far beyond.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze-blue, pearl-pink, ruby-ivory, and emerald RAZE looks wear rainbow knee-high hosiery and pumps with geometric star waist panels before Chisinau's Valea Morilor Cascade Stairs.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze, pale blue, ruby, and cobalt RAZE looks wear rainbow thigh-high stockings and heels beside the Dniester River, with Soroca Fortress and soft distant industrial glow behind them.
